text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking Fenomeno, who has been in a bit of 
a slump lately, I visited a shrine for a 
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, today it was packed with a huge 
crowd of people.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What on earth... could be going on here?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know? It was featured on TV the 
other day as a lucky spot. That's probably 
why.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see, so that's why.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop pushing! I can't breathe!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it! People just keep comin' 
from behind!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, the shrine staff 
can't keep up with the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. I cannot simply stand by and watch 
people suffer in this chaos!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I went to help 
guide the shrine visitors?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down! Excuse me, but please 
evacuate over here for now!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
W-What's your deal, you a security guard 
or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm a student. Please cooperate to 
ensure a safe and smooth visit to the 
shrine!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose you're right. Should I just 
follow behind you, miss?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. Those in the back, please 
form three lines!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Daddy, where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's all right now! This officer is coming 
right away, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fenomeno's hard work, the shrine 
visitors were guided through smoothly 
without any issues. And before we knew it, 
the sun had set—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for keeping you waiting. Shall 
we go pay our respects as well...? Oh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, my body feels lighter. Even after 
running around in that state...
choice_data_list: Maybe God was watching over us after all.
Maybe God was watching after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...If so, I would be thrilled, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, I'd like to offer my 
thanks to the gods, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much for everything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her deed was recognized even by 
the heavens, for Fenomeno completely 
regained her top form.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm beat, sir... Guess I pushed 
myself a bit too hard while feeling under 
the weather.
choice_data_list: Let's hurry home and get some rest

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, Boss...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Doing unscheduled labor left Fenomeno 
thoroughly exhausted."
